## Type of change

- [ ] Feature (`feature/*`)
- [ ] Fix (`hotfix/*` or `feature/*`)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build, CI, or tooling
- [ ] Release (`release/*`)

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows Git Flow and targets `develop` (or `main` for a release or hotfix).
- [ ] CI passes: lint, tests, dependency audit, container build, SBOM.
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behaviour changed, or the reason none were needed is stated below.
- [ ] Documentation in `docs/` updated where this change affects scope, requirements, architecture, or process.
- [ ] `docs/TRACEABILITY_MATRIX.md` updated if a requirement, story, or test was added or changed.
- [ ] Anything inferred rather than stated is marked `(Assumption)` and listed in `docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md`.
- [ ] Anything unanswered is recorded in `docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md` rather than guessed.
- [ ] No secrets, account identifiers, or personal data added in code, configuration, tests, or fixtures.
- [ ] No em dashes introduced in documentation.
